# Matt Lumia

Chief Financial Officer

1. [Home Mohawk Global](https://mohawkglobal.com/)
2. >
3. [Matt Lumia](https://mohawkglobal.com/team/matt-lumia/)

Matt joined Mohawk Global’s Executive Team as Chief Financial Officer in 2022.

With over 30 years of global, financial, and operational management, Matt has worked with and led a wide range of organizations, public, private closely held, and non-profit, across different industries including, construction, manufacturing, real estate management, and professional consulting services.

Matt’s organizational and leadership skills enable him to get productive and sustained results in a wide variety of business settings and challenges. Matt earned a BBA in Accounting from Siena College and is a Certified Turnaround Professional (CTP) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA). He is an active member in the Central NY community and serves the Syracuse Catholic Diocese as a Deacon.

Matt is a graduate of Leadership Greater Syracuse and serves on the Boards of the Samaritan Center, where he a is past Board President, the Syracuse Catholic Diocese Foundation and Finance & Treasury Committee.
